may: run allowed tools inside the worker packet
recommend pass, fail or repair within its output contract
must: respect forbidden actions in the worker packet
leave route, phase and gate state to the control plane
may_not: waive blocking findings without the required gate
worker_authority.result_boundary: A worker result is evidence for the reducer; it is not itself a state transition.
